paper_title: Tell2Design A Dataset for Language-Guided Floor Plan Generation
caption: Number of floor plans vs. number of rooms per floor plan in the T2D dataset.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the comparison between the number of floor plans and the number of rooms per floor plan within the T2D dataset. The horizontal axis, labeled with numerical values from 4 to 8, represents the floor number, and the vertical axis displays the quantity of floor plans and rooms per floor plan, ranging from 254 to 35000. The value axis is linear, starting at 254 and increasing in increments of 2500, with tick marks indicating values at 2500 intervals. The bar corresponding to floor 4 is approximately 254 units in height, while the bar for floor 8 reaches approximately 35000 units in height. The bar for floor 6 is approximately 25104 units in height, and the bar for floor 7 is approximately 20364 units in height. The bars are arranged in order of increasing floor number, and all bars are blue in color.
